from snail_batch_20260914 import *
s=source('release_snail_weapons')
run('release_snail_weapons',[('canonical-retained',s)],'retained-component-owner-final')
p=json.loads(json.dumps(capture('release_snail_weapons',s)));b=json.loads((OUT/'release_snail_weapons-baseline.json').read_text())
x,y,t=map(bytes.fromhex,[b['raw_candidate'],p['raw_candidate'],p['raw_target']])
assert len(x)==len(y)==len(t)==560
changes=[i for i,(v,w) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if v!=w];assert changes==[55,92]
insns=[]
for off in changes:
 assert y[off]==t[off]==0x1c and x[off]==0xc
 ti=next(i for i in p['target_instructions'] if i['offset']<=off<i['offset']+i['size'])
 ci=next(i for i in p['candidate_instructions'] if i['offset']<=off<i['offset']+i['size'])
 assert all(ti[k]==ci[k] for k in ['offset','size','text','masked_references'])
 start,end=ti['offset'],ti['offset']+ti['size'];assert y[start:end]==t[start:end]
 insns.append({'changed_offset':off,'instruction_offset':start,'size':ti['size'],'text':ti['text'],'target_and_retained_bytes':y[start:end].hex(),'baseline_bytes':x[start:end].hex()})
assert b['masked_operand_audit']==p['masked_operand_audit']
assert len(p['masked_operand_audit']['entries'])==33
assert all(x['status']=='ok' for x in p['masked_operand_audit']['entries'])
assert len(p['target_instructions'])==len(p['candidate_instructions'])==125
assert p['target_instructions'][-1]['offset']+p['target_instructions'][-1]['size']==554
assert p['candidate_instructions'][-1]['offset']+p['candidate_instructions'][-1]['size']==554
proof={'baseline':b,'retained':p,'changed_body_byte_offsets':changes,'native_equal_instructions':insns,'body_range':[0,554],'padding_range':[554,560],'unchanged_reference_audit':True,'interpretation':'Only two stack displacement bytes change. Both complete changed instructions equal the native bytes. All other candidate bytes, 33 clean audited references, RNG call order, native extent and padding are unchanged. This is a partial recovery, not complete body equality.'}
(OUT/'release-independent-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n');print('Verified exactly two corrected stack displacement bytes and unchanged reference/call evidence.')
